title: REYDELO_COMANDOS 99 noches en el bosque NO KEY
features: 👑 REYDELO  CONTIENE OPCIONES MUY BUENAS PARA SOBREVIVIR 100 DÍAS EN EL BOSQUE NO TIENE KEY Y POR HAORA.........
tags: Farm madera chatarra comida salud y movimiento
script:
-- [[ 👑 CREADOR: REYDELO_COMANDOS ☑️ ]]
-- VERSIÓN: FINAL BOSS BLINDADA ✓
-- [[ ✅ MÚSICA REPARADA | ✅ TP NIÑOS EXACTO | ✅ ESTILO PREMIUM ]]

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "👑 REYDELO_COMANDOS | PREMIUM SYSTEM",
   LoadingTitle = "CARGANDO PROTOCOLOS DE SEGURIDAD...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "By: REYDELO_COMANDOS",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   Theme = "BloodTheme", 
})

-- [[ MOTOR DE AUDIO INTEGRADO ]]
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Music = SoundService:FindFirstChild("ReydeloRadio") or Instance.new("Sound", SoundService)
Music.Name = "ReydeloRadio"
Music.Looped = true
Music.Volume = 1

local Songs = {
    ["Principal"] = "1848354536",
    ["Track 1"] = "127111756705590",
    ["Track 2"] = "82210016119269",
    ["Track 3"] = "90359988371949",
    ["Track 4"] = "126101841412059",
    ["Track 5"] = "114339730158889",
    ["Track 6"] = "101606511614138"
}

-- [[ FUNCIÓN DE SUCCIÓN MEJORADA ]]
local function PullItem(targetName)
    pcall(function()
        for _, obj in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name:lower():find(targetName:lower()) and obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj.Anchored then
                obj.CFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, -5)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- [[ 📩 PESTAÑA: MENSAJE ORIGINAL ]]
local TabMsg = Window:CreateTab("📜 REYDELO", 4483362458)
TabMsg:CreateSection("AVISO IMPORTANTE")
TabMsg:CreateParagraph({
    Title = "MENSAJE DE REYDELO_COMANDOS", 
    Content = "no fue muy fácil como yo pensé en aserl el script posiblemente haya un 25% de que haya errores y que algunas acciones no funcionan ok !"
})

-- [[ 🎵 PESTAÑA: MÚSICA (FIX TOTAL) ]]
local TabMusic = Window:CreateTab("🎧 MÚSICA", 4483362143)
TabMusic:CreateSection("REPRODUCTOR PROFESIONAL")

TabMusic:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Elegir Canción",
    Options = {"Principal", "Track 1", "Track 2", "Track 3", "Track 4", "Track 5", "Track 6"},
    Callback = function(selected)
        local songName = type(selected) == "table" and selected[1] or selected
        if Songs[songName] then
            Music:Stop()
            Music.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. Songs[songName]
            Music:Play()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "MÚSICA", Content = "Reproduciendo: " .. songName, Duration = 3})
        end
    end,
})

TabMusic:CreateSlider({
    Name = "VELOCIDAD / PITCH",
    Range = {0.5, 3},
    Increment = 0.1,
    CurrentValue = 1,
    Callback = function(v) Music.Pitch = v end,
})

TabMusic:CreateSlider({
    Name = "VOLUMEN",
    Range = {0, 10},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 5,
    Callback = function(v) Music.Volume = v / 2 end,
})

TabMusic:CreateButton({Name = "APAGAR SONIDO", Callback = function() Music:Stop() end})

-- [[ 🏃 PESTAÑA: MOVIMIENTO ]]
local TabMove = Window:CreateTab("⚡ MOVIMIENTO", 4483362458)
TabMove:CreateSection("VUELO Y VELOCIDAD")
TabMove:CreateButton({Name = "✈️ ACTIVAR ZENO FLY", Callback = function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-zeno-fly-64314"))() end})
TabMove:CreateSlider({Name = "Velocidad Flash", Range = {16, 500}, Increment = 10, CurrentValue = 16, Callback = function(v) game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v end})
TabMove:CreateToggle({Name = "Salto Infinito", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) _G.InfJump = v end})

-- [[ 👦 PESTAÑA: NIÑOS (FIX 1-4) ]]
local TabKids = Window:CreateTab("👶 RESCATE", 4483362748)
TabKids:CreateSection("TP NIÑOS (SISTEMA DE LISTA)")
for i=1, 4 do 
    TabKids:CreateButton({Name = "📍 Teletransportar Niño "..i, Callback = function() 
        pcall(function()
            local kidsList = {}
            for _, v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetDescendants()) do 
                if v.Name:lower():find("kid") and (v:IsA("Model") or v:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    table.insert(kidsList, v)
                end
            end
            table.sort(kidsList, function(a,b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
            
            if kidsList[i] then 
                local targetObj = kidsList[i]:IsA("Model") and (kidsList[i].PrimaryPart or kidsList[i]:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) or kidsList[i]
                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetObj.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "RESCATE", Content = "Llegaste con el Niño "..i, Duration = 2})
            else
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "ERROR", Content = "Niño "..i.." no encontrado.", Duration = 2})
            end
        end)
    end}) 
end

-- [[ PESTAÑAS DE CATEGORÍAS (RESTAURADAS) ]]
local function CreateCategory(tabName, icon, items)
    local tab = Window:CreateTab(tabName, icon)
    tab:CreateSection("RECOLECCIÓN")
    for _, name in pairs(items) do
        tab:CreateButton({Name = "Traer: "..name, Callback = function() PullItem(name) end})
    end
end

CreateCategory("📦 CHATARRA", 6031289116, {"Scrap", "Metal", "Fan", "Radiator", "Spring", "Wheel", "Electronic", "Gear", "Pipe", "Screw", "Motor", "Battery", "Wire"})
CreateCategory("🥩 COMIDA", 4483362224, {"Meat", "Soup", "Apple", "Berry", "Water", "Fish", "Bread", "Canned"})
CreateCategory("🏥 SALUD", 6023426920, {"Medkit", "Bandage", "Pills", "Splint", "Syringe", "Adrenaline"})
CreateCategory("🔥 FUEGO", 10734950309, {"Log", "Plank", "Stick", "Coal", "Gas", "Jerrycan", "Match"})
CreateCategory("🔫 ARMAS", 4483345998, {"Rifle", "Shotgun", "Pistol", "Axe", "Machete", "Knife", "Ammo", "Bullet"})

-- [[ BUCLE DE SALTO INFINITO ]]
game:GetService("UserInputService").JumpRequest:Connect(function() 
    if _G.InfJump then game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState("Jumping") end 
end)

Rayfield:Notify({Title = "SISTEMA OK", Content = "Todo configurado correctamente, REYDELO_COMANDOS.", Duration = 5})
